job.title: Java Software Engineer
job.description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer

We are scaling a long-term full-stack engineering hub in Sheffield for a premier global financial institution.

We are looking for a number of high-calibre Senior Full-Stack Engineers with strong technical leadership capabilities who combine hands-on coding with product thinking and delivery ownership.

In this role, you will build and modernise secure, scalable banking platforms using enterprise technologies across backend, cloud, and integration layers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable microservices and RESTful APIs using Java (Java 21+), Python, or Go to support complex enterprise integration.
  • Build and integrate backend solutions spanning legacy core banking platforms, modern orchestration layers, and AWS-based cloud services.
  • Containerise and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes to ensure high availability and robust scalability.
  • Remain hands-on with engineering, code reviews, and database design (PostgreSQL/Liquibase) while guiding wider technical direction and delivery.
  • Translate complex business requirements into high-performance engineering outcomes and mentor high-performing teams.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Deep hands-on experience in enterprise software development (Java 21+, Spring Boot, Microservices, and API development).
  • Strong background across hybrid backend architectures, combining legacy systems, modern orchestration layers, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven technical leadership with the ability to bridge deep technical detail and wider business outcomes.
  • Full right to work in the UK without sponsorship and willingness to work on-site in Sheffield 2 days per week.

job.title: Engineering Lead- Bidwork-EY/LBG
job.description:
Engineering Lead
Location: London, UK
Industry: Banking / Financial Services
Engagement: Contract / Transformation Programme
Overview
We are supporting a major UK banking transformation programme and are seeking an experienced Engineering Lead to bridge strategy, architecture, and delivery. The successful candidate will be responsible for translating architectural vision into executable engineering outcomes, shaping delivery plans, setting engineering standards, and providing technical leadership across complex product and technology initiatives.
This role is ideal for a Principal Engineer, Senior Staff Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, or Engineering Lead who thrives in large-scale enterprise environments and can work effectively across Product, Architecture, Engineering, and Business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities

  • Translate target architecture and strategic outcomes into executable engineering roadmaps and delivery plans.
  • Break complex business and technology objectives into epics, features, and delivery increments.
  • Define engineering standards, governance frameworks, and technical guardrails.
  • Shape delivery teams and identify the technical skills required to achieve programme outcomes.
  • Lead technical discovery activities and engineering workshops.
  • Challenge delivery estimates, technical assumptions, and implementation approaches.
  • Partner closely with Product Owners, Architects, and delivery stakeholders to align business and technical priorities.
  • Drive engineering best practice across software development, architecture, cloud adoption, and platform engineering.
  • Identify and remove technical risks, blockers, and dependencies that could impact delivery.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to engineering teams within a fast-paced transformation environment.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience operating as an Engineering Lead, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, or similar senior engineering position.
  • Experience leading engineering delivery within large-scale enterprise or banking environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Demonstrable experience translating architecture into engineering execution.
  • Experience defining engineering standards, delivery governance, and technical operating models.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams through complex transformation programmes.

Technical Skills
Whilst the final technology stack is being confirmed, candidates should demonstrate deep engineering expertise and broad full-stack awareness.
Preferred experience includes:

  • Java
  • Spring Boot
  • Microservices Architecture
  • REST APIs
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Kubernetes and Containerisation
  • CI/CD and DevOps Practices
  • Event-Driven Architectures
  • Distributed Systems
  • Modern Engineering Tooling and Platform Engineering

Desired Background
Candidates are likely to come from the following backgrounds:

  • Engineering Lead
  • Principal Engineer
  • Principal Software Engineer
  • Senior Staff Engineer
  • Staff Engineer
  • Lead Software Engineer
  • Lead Java Developer
  • Technical Lead
  • Engineering Manager
  • Software Engineering Manager

Experience within large banking, financial services, fintech, or enterprise technology organisations is highly desirable.
Key Attributes

  • Strong technical leadership and decision-making capability.
  • Pragmatic approach to balancing engineering quality and delivery outcomes.
  • Ability to operate effectively within ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.
  • Outcome-focused mindset with a commercial awareness of delivery objectives.
  • Collaborative style, able to work across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Risk, and Business teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving and technical discovery skills.

What's on Offer

  • Opportunity to lead engineering delivery on a major banking transformation programme.
  • Exposure to large-scale modernisation and customer-focused transformation initiatives.
  • Influence engineering strategy, standards, and delivery practices.
  • Work alongside senior product, architecture, and technology leaders.
  • High-profile role with significant impact across business and technology functions.


Ideal Candidate
A highly experienced engineering leader with 7-10+ years of software engineering experience, capable of converting architecture into actionable delivery plans, leading cross-functional engineering teams, and driving successful outcomes within complex enterprise environments. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth, delivery leadership, architectural understanding, and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

job.title: 2nd line IT Engineer
job.description:
As a Level 2 IT Support Engineer, you will provide comprehensive support services to our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain fully operational. This role involves proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems, and restoring service to clients by managing incidents through to resolution. Reporting to the 2nd Line Team Leader, your responsibilities will include a mix of proactive monitoring and maintenance, as well as business-as-usual support.
In addition to IT support, you will also provide network support to clients. Familiarity with Meraki, Fortinet, Zyxel, and Sonicwall network technologies is essential. Experience in an MSP support role is crucial. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a strong desire to continue learning and developing their technical skills.

Responsibilities:

• Incident Management: Efficiently handle and resolve incidents escalated from 1st line support within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Problem Management: Analyse incident trends to identify recurring issues and work towards root cause resolution to prevent future occurrences.
• Technical Support: Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical support for complex issues across a wide range of enterprise systems and applications.
• Change Management: Review and implement changes to the IT environment, ensuring they comply with Change Management procedures and minimise disruption.
• Knowledge Management: Document solutions and workarounds for common issues to enhance the knowledge base and assist 1st line support in resolving incidents faster.
• Service Request Fulfilment: Process and fulfil service requests that require more technical expertise than 1st line support can provide.
• Customer Communication: Maintain clear and professional communication with customers regarding the status of their incidents and requests.
• Escalation Handling: Escalate unresolved issues to 3rd line support or external vendors as necessary, ensuring detailed documentation and communication.
• Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis for major incidents and problems to prevent recurrence and improve service reliability.
• Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyse system performance metrics to proactively identify and resolve potential issues.


Requirements:

• Proficiency in diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, including desktops, laptops, servers, and network devices.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Intune and Defender
• In-depth knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems, with experience in Linux/Unix environments being advantageous.
• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and the ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues.
• Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools such Halo ITSM for incident and request management.
• Basic scripting skills in languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automating routine tasks and improving efficiency.
• Experience with Active Directory administration, including user account management, group policies, and permissions.
• Ability to support and troubleshoot a variety of enterprise applications, including Microsoft Office Suite, email clients, and other business software.

job.title: AI Automation Engineer.
job.description:
This role is a key part of a dedicated design team driving creative innovation within the enterprise Marketing Team of a global leader in the Tech industry. As the first hire of this profile for a newly formed creative production model, you will be the technical architect behind the studio’s automated and agentic production pipelines, building tools that allow us to scale paid media creative across EMEA at speed.


You will not just use AI tools, you will build them. You will be responsible for engineering the agentic infrastructure, custom internal applications, and automated workflows that power the creative studio. This includes building custom agents in platforms like Claude, context-engineering multi-modal workflows, and handling the technical plumbing required.


We need a technically fluent engineer with a deep curiosity for creative workflows. You will build systems that can automatically read design systems, understand template libraries, process creative performance APIs, and generate scaled static and video ads. You bring a logical, builder mindset to translate complex creative requirements into robust, automated software solutions.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, build, and deploy agentic workflows and custom internal tools utilizing Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and API ecosystems to automate the generation of static and video ad assets.
• Architect and manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and configurations, establishing secure, standardized connections between LLM applications and our external tools, data sources, and asset repositories.
• Develop and maintain the technical plumbing and API integrations connecting performance data pipelines, media libraries, and production software.
• Engineer advanced context and prompt frameworks, utilizing MCP and other tooling to ensure context such as brand guidelines, design specs, program specific data sources are accessible and agent-readable.
• Build automated agents capable of reading design systems, parsing creative template libraries, and outputting production-ready static and video assets.

________________________________________
Knowledge, Skills & Experience
• Proven experience building agentic tools, multi-agent frameworks, and automated workflows using orchestration libraries like LangChain, CrewAI, or StackAI.
• Deep programmatic fluency with LLM APIs (specifically Anthropic Claude and OpenAI SDKs), vector databases (such as Pinecone or Chroma), and retrieval-augmented generation concepts.
• Hands-on experience developing with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
• Strong software development fundamentals in Python and JavaScript/Node.js with extensive experience building, connecting, and securing REST APIs.
• Familiarity with context engineering, prompt architecture, and structured data formats (JSON, XML) used to drive automated design and video workflows.

job.title: Transition PMO Manager
job.description:
Transition PMO Manager


Location: London, UK (Hybrid)
Contract Type: Interim / Contract
Duration: January 2027 – July 2027 (Approx. 7 Months)
Day Rate: Up to £500 per day
Working Pattern: Full Time

About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Transition PMO Manager to join a major international transition programme delivering a large-scale managed services transformation across multiple countries.
This is a pivotal role responsible for leading the Programme Management Office throughout the transition lifecycle, ensuring robust governance, planning, reporting, milestone management, financial tracking, and programme controls are maintained across nine workstreams operating in eight countries.
Working closely with the Transition Director, workstream leads, client stakeholders, and delivery partners, you will provide accurate reporting, commercial visibility, and governance oversight to ensure successful delivery against key contractual and operational milestones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and manage the integrated programme plan across nine workstreams and eight countries.
  • Coordinate dependencies across internal delivery teams, suppliers, and client-led programmes.
  • Track delivery milestones and manage the collection of acceptance evidence for contractual sign-off.
  • Own and maintain RAID, dependency, decision, action, and change control logs.
  • Produce weekly Transition Board packs and fortnightly Steering Committee reporting.
  • Prepare programme reporting for key commercial and contractual review points.
  • Track programme resources, including FTE utilisation and contractor effort against plan.
  • Monitor programme costs, forecasts, and budgets to support open-book reporting and invoicing.
  • Ensure effective document management, governance controls, and programme administration.
  • Support senior leadership with accurate management information, reporting, and delivery insights.

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years' PMO experience within large-scale IT transition, transformation, migration, or change programmes.
  • Proven experience supporting programmes valued at £2 million or more.
  • Strong programme governance, reporting, planning, and controls experience.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent enterprise planning tools.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial and resource tracking.
  • Experience managing milestone-based delivery reporting and time-and-materials commercial models.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments.
  • IT outsourcing transitions and service migrations.
  • Multi-supplier programme environments.
  • Prime contractor delivery models.
  • Power BI reporting and dashboard development.
  • International or multi-country transformation programmes.

Qualifications

  • P3O Practitioner or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification.
  • APM PMQ or equivalent project/programme management qualification desirable.

What We're Looking For


This opportunity would suit a highly organised PMO professional with a strong background in complex technology programmes. You will be comfortable operating in fast-paced environments, managing competing priorities, and providing the governance, reporting, and commercial oversight required to support successful programme delivery.

What’s on Offer

  • Day rate of up to £500 per day
  • High-profile international transition programme
  • Hybrid working arrangement
  • Opportunity to work alongside senior client stakeholders and delivery partners
  • Immediate involvement in a business-critical transformation initiative

job.title: SC Cleared Automation Tester
job.description:

experience across UI, API and data testing. The role requires proven expertise in
designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks using Selenium,
Playwright, Cucumber/BDD, Java and Python, along with strong API testing and

skills are required for data validation and backend testing. The candidate should

• Proven experience in designing, implementing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks.
• Strong experience with Selenium and Playwright for UI automation.
• Strong API testing and automation experience using Postman, Rest Assured and Karate.
• Hands-on experience with Cucumber and Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD), including developing and maintaining BDD-based automated test scenarios.
• Strong programming/scripting skills in Java and Python.
• Strong SQL skills, including complex queries for data validation, reconciliation and backend testing.
• Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and data validation/testing.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across UI, API and data layers.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Azure Databricks | Selenium | Playwright | Postman | Karate | Cucumber/BDD | Java | Python | SQL | CI/CD | Jira | Xray | Spark4GL

job.title: Java Software Engineer (Java, Glasgow)

Location: Glasgow (Hybrid - Minimum 2 Days Onsite Per Week)
Salary: Up to £500 per day (Inside IR35)
Contract: Initial 6-Month Contract with a Strong View to Permanent Employment

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join a newly established engineering capability delivering strategic technology solutions within the financial services sector.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on engineer with strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot alongside Angular and/or React. You'll play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering secure, scalable, enterprise-grade applications while contributing to engineering standards and best practices across multiple high-profile projects.

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular or React.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices-based solutions.
  • Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps engineers, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, technical design sessions, and code reviews.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps initiatives, and Agile delivery practices.
  • Ensure solutions meet security, performance, accessibility, and operational requirements.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to support successful project delivery.

  • Strong commercial experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Front-end development expertise using Angular and/or React.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience working within financial services, banking, insurance, or other regulated environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery teams.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit, Jest, or Cypress.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools including Terraform or Ansible.
  • Knowledge of monitoring, observability, and performance optimisation.
  • Previous consulting experience.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to engineering best practices.

What's on Offer

  • Up to £500 per day Inside IR35
  • Initial 6-month contract
  • Strong opportunity to secure a permanent position following the contract period
  • Hybrid working environment with a minimum of two days per week onsite in Glasgow
  • Exposure to complex, enterprise-scale technology programmes
  • Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and technology leaders
  • Long-term career growth within an expanding technology consulting practice

Apply

If you are a Full Stack Engineer with strong Java and modern front-end development experience and are looking for a challenging role with long-term career prospects, we would welcome your application.

Please submit your CV for immediate consideration.
